about: compiler/task: task record/stat-cache serialization, DoD Tarjan/Kahn dependency graph, affected propagation, child env masking, Go gen closure parsing, and verdict replay engine (SELFHOST-TASK-PROFMD-SIZES).

mutants.name: selfhost-task-stat-excludes-racy
mutants.to: if true || mtime < racyNanos && ctime < racyNanos {
mutants.rule: EncodeStatCache must omit racy entries modified at or after racyNanos.

mutants.name: selfhost-task-graph-edge-parent-dir
mutants.rule: EdgesOf must emit a dependency edge from producer to consumer when an output feeds an input file or listed directory.

mutants.name: selfhost-task-affected-propagates-downstream
mutants.rule: ComputeAffected must propagate affectedness transitively down dependency edges.

mutants.name: selfhost-task-env-masks-grant-lease
mutants.rule: EnvKey must mask ERGO_BUDGET_GRANT values so dynamic lease IDs do not bust the cache key.

mutants.name: selfhost-task-verdicts-replay-hit
mutants.rule: runSingleVerdict must replay stored passing verdicts when not running in Fresh mode.

mutants.name: selfhost-task-rungen-contradiction-check
mutants.to:
if false && hit && !SameOutputs(stored, outs) {
